chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Yusuf, from Mu'adh ibn Thabit, from 'Amr ibn Jumay', he raised it to 'Ali (peace be upon him) who said:
It is from the Sunnah that when the Imam ascends the pulpit, he should offer the greeting of peace when he faces the people.

key_terms.الْمِنْبَرَ: The pulpit (minbar, raised platform in a mosque)
key_terms.يُسَلِّمَ: To offer the greeting of peace (salam)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended etiquette for the Imam when ascending the pulpit for Friday prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* codifies the etiquette of the Friday sermon (Khutbah), emphasizing that the Imam’s initial greeting of peace upon facing the congregation is a established Sunnah. It underscores the importance of dignified leadership and communal connection in Shia jurisprudence, linking the ritual authority of the Imam to the prophetic tradition of respectful engagement with the faithful.
